tools.name: search
tools.description: Search UkraineBorder's guides for foreign travellers to Ukraine (border crossings, customs, safety, visas and war-risk travel insurance) across 10 languages. Returns matching documents with ids to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a UkraineBorder document by the id returned from search.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search UkraineBorder articles in a specific language; returns top relevant chunks with links.

tools.name: get_cluster_summary
tools.description: Structured summary of a topic cluster (border-crossings, customs, safety, insurance, essentials) in the requested language, with its guide list.

tools.name: get_insurance_facts
tools.description: Regulatory facts about the war-risk + radiation-risk travel insurance product and the licensed entities behind it (insurer, agent, regulator, registry).

tools.name: estimate_quote
tools.description: Approximate price for a war-risk travel policy, computed locally from published rates; not a partner quote and not a binding offer. The exact amount is calculated and charged during checkout on ukraineborder.com.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Build a checkout link to ukraineborder.com with the trip parameters pre-filled, so the traveller completes identity, email verification and payment there. Carries no personal data: only non-personal trip parameters in the URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
